article.title: Triton公布音訊廣告Seller Agent交易案例，事前由人手設定價格與驗證規則
article.title_en: Triton reports an agent-to-agent audio ad buy with human-defined guardrails
article.summary: Triton Digital於10月28日公布Seller Agent，並表示已與Talpa Media及代理商Draft Digital為Otrium完成一宗由AI代理溝通及預訂的音訊廣告交易。
article.summary_en: Triton Digital announced its Seller Agent on October 28 and said it completed an agent-to-agent audio ad transaction for Otrium with Talpa Media and agency Draft Digital.
article.why: 對代理商與媒體，案例的可參考之處是把審核條件預先轉為交易規則。自動預訂能否適用，仍取決於庫存、定價及責任邊界是否清楚。
article.why_en: The case offers a workflow example of moving review criteria into transaction rules. Suitability depends on clear inventory, pricing and accountability boundaries.
article.next_step: 以一種音訊庫存盤點價格底線、預算上限、資料及品牌安全規則，再詢問供應商能否提供可稽核的交易紀錄。
article.next_step_en: Map price floors, budget caps, data and brand-safety rules for one audio product, then ask for auditable transaction records.
highlights: 公司表示代理完成需求配對、條款協商及廣告伺服器預訂，活動透過Talpa Media的Sync運作。
Triton及代理商團隊在代理執行前設定條款、價格護欄及資料、私隱與活動驗證標準。
highlights_en: Triton says agents matched requirements, aligned terms and booked in the ad server, with the campaign running through Talpa Media’s Sync.
Triton and agency teams set terms, pricing guardrails and data, privacy and campaign-validation standards before execution.
article.detail:
Triton Digital於10月28日公布Seller Agent，並表示已與Talpa Media及代理商Draft Digital為Otrium完成一宗由AI代理溝通及預訂的音訊廣告交易。

公司表示代理完成需求配對、條款協商及廣告伺服器預訂，活動透過Talpa Media的Sync運作。

Triton及代理商團隊在代理執行前設定條款、價格護欄及資料、私隱與活動驗證標準。

對代理商與媒體，案例的可參考之處是把審核條件預先轉為交易規則。自動預訂能否適用，仍取決於庫存、定價及責任邊界是否清楚。

以一種音訊庫存盤點價格底線、預算上限、資料及品牌安全規則，再詢問供應商能否提供可稽核的交易紀錄。

這是公司公布的單一案例；本刊未獨立驗證交易速度、行業第一或銷售提升，亦不推定全部市場已開放。
article.detail_en:
Triton Digital announced its Seller Agent on October 28 and said it completed an agent-to-agent audio ad transaction for Otrium with Talpa Media and agency Draft Digital.

Triton says agents matched requirements, aligned terms and booked in the ad server, with the campaign running through Talpa Media’s Sync.

Triton and agency teams set terms, pricing guardrails and data, privacy and campaign-validation standards before execution.

The case offers a workflow example of moving review criteria into transaction rules. Suitability depends on clear inventory, pricing and accountability boundaries.

Map price floors, budget caps, data and brand-safety rules for one audio product, then ask for auditable transaction records.

This is a company-reported case. Transaction speed, industry-first status and sales lift were not independently verified; broad availability is not assumed.
